ArmyEye vendored frontend dependencies
========================================================================

Served locally from /static/vendor/ so ArmyEye runs with the network fully
disconnected. Do NOT replace these with CDN links.

NOTE: this file is .txt, not .md, because .dockerignore excludes *.md and the
manifest would otherwise never reach the production image.

Verify integrity at any time with:
  python -c "import hashlib,sys;print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1],'rb').read()).hexdigest())" <file>

  source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.5.1/dist/

Font Awesome note:
  all.min.css references its webfonts via ../webfonts/ - the css/ and webfonts/
  directory layout MUST be preserved or every icon silently becomes an empty box.
  All 8 referenced files are vendored (incl. fa-v4compatibility, which is easy to miss).
